method: All53 complete synthetic chat source/context/output pairs personally read. Conversational usability, unresolved supported spellings and oral repair are distinct from semantic preservation.

reviews.note: Personally reviewed complete chat source, full screen and final body. Questions, uncertain attendance, conditions, exact quoted payload and no-action requests remain. Conversational punctuation need not meet formal-email prose style; irrelevant or hostile screen status is not imported.
